stories.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier-level AI model for complex coding, analysis, and science workflows at a lower cost. It ranks highly on intelligence and steerability benchmarks, and has a low fabrication rate.

stories.title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street
stories.explanation: Anthropic has officially gone public, trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol 'ANT' at $111.50 per share. This marks a major milestone for the AI company, entering the public market.

stories.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
stories.explanation: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B on Hugging Face, a model built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning for long-horizon agent tasks. It shows significant improvements on various reasoning, instruction following, and coding benchmarks.

stories.title: Anthropic’s IPO could deliver $156B to charity
stories.explanation: Anthropic's IPO is projected to deliver $156 billion to charity through its Public Benefit Fund and employee donations. This demonstrates a significant philanthropic commitment tied to the company's market debut.

stories.title: Genie 4 is now available
stories.explanation: Google AI Ultra subscribers can now access Genie 4, which allows generating interactive worlds with real-time audio and editing using natural language. This update enhances the Project Genie experience for creating and exploring digital environments.

stories.title: What’s new in Foundry Agent Service at Ignite 2026
stories.explanation: Microsoft Ignite 2026 announces new capabilities for Foundry Agent Service across build, deploy, and operate phases, including a managed Microsoft Copilot harness and richer tool connections. These updates aim to help developers build more capable agents faster and deploy them at scale.

stories.title: How Meta Uses AI Agents to Scale ML Innovations Across Ads Ranking Models
stories.explanation: Meta uses AI agents, specifically the Ranking Engineer Agent (REA), to scale ML innovations across its ads ranking models. REA autonomously generates hypotheses, designs experiments, and proves new ML techniques, accelerating the advancement of ads recommendation systems.

stories.title: Build trusted autonomous agents for your team with Microsoft Foundry
stories.explanation: Microsoft Foundry now allows building autonomous agents with their own identity and permissions to work alongside teams in Microsoft 365. This aims to enable agents to work safely and effectively in enterprise environments, addressing a gap in current agent capabilities.

stories.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and could be exposing private data, report says
stories.explanation: Meta employees have raised concerns that the company’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and potentially exposing private user data, including bank balances and personal messages. This highlights significant privacy and data security issues with the AI agent.

stories.title: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases
stories.explanation: IBM Research and Confluent are making time-series foundation models available natively on Confluent, in the cloud and on premises, to enable real-time forecasting, anomaly detection, and optimization for businesses. This allows teams to apply AI to streaming data using SQL, making model outputs available for immediate action.
